requirement_groups.name: The Commercial and Industrial Wiring certificate program equips students with the technical skills and knowledge required to install, maintain, and troubleshoot electrical systems in commercial and industrial environments. This program emphasizes hands-on training in wiring techniques, safety protocols, blueprint interpretation, and adherence to the National Electrical Code (NEC). Graduates will be prepared for entry-level positions in the electrical industry, with the ability to work on complex electrical systems in various commercial and industrial settings.

The Industrial Instrumentation certificate program provides students with the foundational knowledge and technical skills required to work with instrumentation and process control systems in industrial settings. The program covers essential topics such as motor controls, industrial electronics, and both DC and AC electrical fundamentals. Through hands-on training and theoretical instruction, students will learn to install, maintain, and troubleshoot instrumentation systems, preparing them for entry-level positions in various industrial environments, including manufacturing, power generation, and automation industries.
